Q10.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c02 AS airline_name, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights
FROM th77
LEFT JOIN tx7n ON th77.c01 = tx7n.c04
WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed'
GROUP BY th77.c02
ORDER BY completed_flights DESC, airline_name;
```

Q11.raw:
```sql
SELECT t1.c01 AS customer_id, t1.c02 AS name, ROUND(SUM(t2.c09), 2) AS total_declared_value_usd
FROM th77 t1
JOIN tu5q t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c04
JOIN tx7n t3 ON t2.c01 = t3.c04
WHERE t3.c19 != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY t1.c01, t1.c02
ORDER BY total_declared_value_usd DESC, t1.c01 ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

Q12.raw:
```sql
SELECT c02 AS iata_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_arrivals 
FROM tx7n 
WHERE c19 = 'completed' 
GROUP BY c02 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 150 
ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC, iata_code ASC;
```

Q13.raw:
```sql
SELECT t1.c02 AS iata_code, ROUND(AVG(t2.c16 - t2.c08), 1) AS avg_departure_delay_min
FROM ts53 AS t1
JOIN tx7n AS t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c05
WHERE t2.c19 = 'completed'
GROUP BY t1.c02
HAVING COUNT(t2.c01) >= 40
ORDER BY avg_departure_delay_min DESC, t1.c02;
```

Q14.raw: SELECT c01, c02 FROM th77 WHERE c01 NOT IN (SELECT c03 FROM tx7n WHERE c19 != 'cancelled') ORDER BY c01

Q15.raw:
```sql
SELECT t1.c01 AS customer_id, SUM(t2.c09) AS total_invoiced_usd, SUM(t3.c11) AS total_paid_usd, ROUND(SUM(t2.c09) - SUM(t3.c11), 2) AS outstanding_usd
FROM th77 t1
LEFT JOIN tajj t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c03
LEFT JOIN t8tg t3 ON t2.c01 = t3.c03
WHERE t2.c15 = 'unpaid' OR t3.c12 = 1
GROUP BY t1.c01
ORDER BY outstanding_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Q16.raw:
```sql
SELECT trhn.c04 AS service_level, COUNT(*) AS connecting_shipments
FROM trhn
JOIN tx7n ON trhn.c03 = tx7n.c01
WHERE tx7n.c03 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY trhn.c04
ORDER BY trhn.c04;
```

Q17.raw:
```sql
SELECT t6sc.c02 AS model, ROUND(SUM(tu5q.c09 * t89v.c13) / MAX(tu5q.c10) * 100, 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct
FROM t6sc
JOIN tu5q ON t6sc.c01 = tu5q.c01
JOIN t89v ON tu5q.c05 = t89v.c01
WHERE tu5q.c16 = 'completed'
GROUP BY t6sc.c02
ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC;
```

Q18.raw:
```sql

  strftime('%Y-%m', tx7n.c04) AS month,

FROM 
  tx7n 
JOIN 
  t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01
```

Q19.raw:
```sql
SELECT ts53.c02 AS origin_iata, tu5q.c06 AS destination_iata, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights
FROM tx7n
JOIN tu5q ON tx7n.c04 = tu5q.c01
JOIN ts53 ON tx7n.c05 = ts53.c01
WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed'
GROUP BY ts53.c02, tu5q.c06
ORDER BY ts53.c02, destination_iata;
```

Q20.raw:
```sql
SELECT t02.c01 AS shipment_id, ROUND(t02.c10 - t02.c09, 1) AS hours_late
FROM tx7n AS t01
JOIN tu5q AS t02 ON t01.c04 = t02.c01
WHERE t01.c19 = 'delivered'
ORDER BY hours_late DESC, t01.c01
LIMIT 10;
```

Q22.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c01 AS customer_id, MAX(tx7n.c08) AS latest_booking_date, MAX(tx7n.c01) AS shipment_id
FROM th77
JOIN tu5q ON th77.c01 = tu5q.c04
JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04
GROUP BY th77.c01
ORDER BY th77.c01;
```

Q23.raw:
```sql
SELECT t1.c01 AS invoice_id, t3.c02 AS customer_name, julianday('2025-12-20') - julianday(t1.c05) AS days_overdue, ROUND(t1.c09 - SUM(t2.c06), 2) AS outstanding_usd
FROM tajj AS t1
JOIN t8tg AS t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c03
JOIN th77 AS t3 ON t1.c03 = t3.c01
WHERE t1.c05 < '2025-12-20' AND t2.c06 < t1.c09
GROUP BY t1.c01, t3.c02
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, t1.c01
LIMIT 10;
```

Q24.raw:
```sql
SELECT t11.c11 AS commodity_category, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.c01) AS flown_legs, COUNT(DISTINCT t09.c01) AS incidents, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT t09.c01) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t10.c01), 4) AS incident_rate
FROM tajj AS t01
INNER JOIN t8tg AS t02 ON t01.c01 = t02.c03
INNER JOIN th77 AS t03 ON t02.c04 = t03.c01
INNER JOIN t89v AS t04 ON t01.c02 = t04.c01
INNER JOIN tg6t AS t05 ON t02.c01 = t05.c01
INNER JOIN tx7n AS t06 ON t05.c03 = t06.c01
INNER JOIN tu5q AS t07 ON t06.c04 = t07.c01
INNER JOIN ts53 AS t08 ON t07.c06 = t08.c01
INNER JOIN trhn AS t09 ON t06.c05 = t09.c01
INNER JOIN tpsn AS t10 ON t06.c02 = t10.c02
INNER JOIN tcse AS t11 ON t07.c03 = t11.c03
WHERE t06.c18 = 'flown'
GROUP BY t11.c11
ORDER BY incident_rate DESC, commodity_category;
```

Q25.raw:
```sql
SELECT a.c02 AS airport_a, b.c02 AS airport_b, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.c01 < b.c01 THEN a.c01 ELSE b.c01 END) AS flights_a_to_b, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.c01 > b.c01 THEN a.c01 ELSE b.c01 END) AS flights_b_to_a
FROM tx7n a
JOIN tx7n b ON a.c01 <> b.c01 AND (a.c06 = b.c05 AND a.c05 = b.c06)
WHERE a.c19 = 'completed' AND b.c19 = 'completed'
GROUP BY airport_a, airport_b
ORDER BY airport_a, airport_b;
```

Q33.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c12 AS customs_country, SUM(t3v5.c10) AS total_duty_usd, SUM(t3v5.c11) AS total_vat_usd, ROUND(SUM(t3v5.c10) + SUM(t3v5.c11), 2) AS total_taxes_usd
```


Q36.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c02 AS insurer_name, COUNT(t95g.c01) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tm8a.c05 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN tm8a.c10 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd
```

Q37.raw:
```sql
SELECT ts53.c01 AS warehouse_code, ts53.c02 AS iata_code, COUNT(t3z7.c01) AS rcs_scans
FROM ts53
JOIN t3z7 ON ts53.c01 = t3z7.c04
```

Q38.raw:
```sql
SELECT tu5q.c02 AS model, SUM(t875.c11 * 100 / t875.c12) AS fuel_kg_per_100km 
FROM tu5q 
JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 
JOIN t875 ON tx7n.c01 = t875.c03 
WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed'
```

Q39.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c02 AS airline_name, tu5q.c05 AS employee_number, ROUND(SUM(t6sc.c16) / 60, 1) AS block_hours
FROM tu5q
JOIN t6sc ON tu5q.c01 = t6sc.c04
JOIN th77 ON tu5q.c03 = th77.c01
WHERE t6sc.c08 = 'captain' AND tu5q.c16 = 'completed'
```

Q40.raw:
```sql
SELECT t6sc.c02 AS model, ROUND(SUM(t8tg.c06 * t8tg.c07 * t8tg.c08) / SUM(t89v.c13 * t89v.c14), 1) AS grams_per_tonne_km
FROM t6sc
JOIN tu5q ON t6sc.c03 = tu5q.c01
JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04
JOIN t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01
JOIN t8tg ON t89v.c01 = t8tg.c02
WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' AND t89v.c10 = 'delivered'
GROUP BY t6sc.c02
ORDER BY grams_per_tonne_km ASC, t6sc.c02 ASC;
```

Q41.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    th77.c17 AS service_level, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_shipments, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c07 > th77.c14 THEN 1 END) AS late_shipments, 
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c07 > th77.c14 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' THEN 1 END), 1) AS late_pct
FROM 
    th77
JOIN 
    tx7n ON th77.c01 = tx7n.c05
WHERE 
    tx7n.c18 = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    th77.c17
ORDER BY 
    th77.c17;
```

Q42.raw:
```sql
SELECT th77.c12 AS customs_country, COUNT(t3v5.c01) AS cleared_imports, AVG(t3v5.c10 - t3v5.c09) AS avg_clearance_hours
FROM th77
JOIN t3v5 ON th77.c01 = t3v5.c04
WHERE t3v5.c15 = 'import' AND t3v5.c16 = 'cleared'
GROUP BY th77.c12
HAVING COUNT(t3v5.c01) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_clearance_hours ASC, customs_country ASC;
```

Q43.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    t89v.c01 AS shipment_id, 
    t89v.c02 AS awb_number, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t89v.c13 IS NOT NULL AND (t89v.c13 < t89v.c14 OR t89v.c13 > t89v.c15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_readings, 
    MAX(CASE WHEN t89v.c13 IS NOT NULL AND (t89v.c13 < t89v.c14 OR t89v.c13 > t89v.c15) THEN ABS(t89v.c13 - LEAST(t89v.c14, t89v.c15)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_deviation_c
FROM 
    t89v
GROUP BY 
    t89v.c01, 
    t89v.c02
ORDER BY 
    t89v.c01;
```

Q44.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    t1.c05 AS root_cause, 
    COUNT(t1.c01) AS incidents, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t2.c12 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims, 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.c12 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN t2.c11 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd
FROM 
    t95g AS t1
LEFT JOIN 
    tm8a AS t2 ON t1.c03 = t2.c03
GROUP BY 
    t1.c05
ORDER BY 
    t1.c05;
```

Q45.raw:
```sql
SELECT t89v.c02 AS awb_number, ts53.c02 AS destination_iata, t3v5.c15 AS import_status
FROM t89v
JOIN tx7n ON t89v.c01 = tx7n.c01
JOIN ts53 ON t89v.c06 = ts53.c01
LEFT JOIN t3v5 ON t89v.c01 = t3v5.c01 AND t3v5.c05 = 'import'
WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c03 IS NULL
ORDER BY t89v.c02;
```
